author: Teckky
body:
YOU GUYS DID IT, LET YOUR COMMUNITY HEAR IT!

Please note: Most of the information found in this post can be found publicly. Everyone is entitled to there own opinions/points of view but these are the dead facts. 

If you read the title you can see this is a serious post, please read through the whole thing!

===================================
Dear Avicans,
Today I have come to speak about a topic that is really sad and disgusting quite frankly.It has been brought to my attention that one AwarriorVenom(Exzyy & Archeonixx) has recently been banned from Avicus via: Forum, Teamspeak and in game. While viewing his profile you can see there isn't an actually legit reason (he's banned for "Goodbye"). After doing a bit of digging myself I figured out that he was banned for "Leaving 4 times". I skimmed throughout the rules for a long period and didn't find said rule. The actually reason behind his banned was a personal matter between Jozz and Awarrior. Apparently Awarrior was spamming "Jizzmcizz" as a joke, not seriously or anything (guys doing guy things). The chat then got heated, and Awarrior told them he would leave for a few days until things cooled down, then proceeded to leave the chat. Minutes later he was added back and sent a certain .gif from ParaSpider. In the gif it was Para holding a piece of paper with all the map devs names on it, then he rips Awarrior's name off. Okay, you heard that, WHAT THE [Redacted]!?!.. We talked about the gif and Awarrior opened up and told us it had brought tears to his eyes. Now I don't think thats unreasonable, after working hard, making loads and loads of maps for Avicus and then being fucked over like that, really.... Now I have been temp banned in the past for "Bullying Staff Members" and I would like to request a temp-ban for both the people who punished Awarrior and ParaSpider. I would like to see what Avicus is going to do about this. This is truly pathetic, Para your a fucking hypocrite, banning me for "Bullying Staff" and then you go do it yourself. Prove me right, archive this post and don't show the community the corruptness.

Here is the gif

Source: KooDaLord approves this message and was part of my source.

Thanks for talking the time to read!
